prBodyNotes: Pin policy (GH #103): any change to the workspace Cargo.lock must sync benchmarks/tablo/Cargo.lock in the same commit, keeping topcoat/toasty revs identical.
Topcoat and Toasty are pinned to exact revs and bumped with cargo xtask bump-upstream, never by Renovate or a blanket cargo update.

packageRules.description: Topcoat and Toasty stay pinned; bump via cargo xtask bump-upstream
argon2 + password-hash bump as one coupled set, never separately
